transfer_from_invoked.meaning: transferFrom(from, to, amount) is invoked on TokenWrapper using an allowance

from_holder_is_actual_holder.meaning: the from parameter identifies the actual token holder whose balance is debited

event_from_address.meaning: the from address recorded in the emitted Transfer event

holder_address.meaning: the token holder whose balance decreases (the from parameter)

explorer_shows_holder_as_origin.meaning: block explorers display the actual token holder as the originating address and the user sees the TokenWrapper transfer in their sent transactions list

assumptions: Off-chain systems and smart contract integrations rely on Transfer events to attribute token movements to the correct sender.
The spender is a legitimate allowance user; no unauthorized-call condition is claimed.

unresolved.description: The impact's off-chain display outcome (explorer sent-transactions list) is not a purely on-chain observable; it is represented by a grounded Boolean whose binding to explorer behavior is deferred.

limitations: The explorer display effect is modeled as a Boolean observable; its concrete off-chain rendering is not numerically defined in the report.
Only the i_explorer_history_wrong impact is formalized; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
